text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро МакКуин sails through the
Kikuka Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро Райан is obviously frustrated, but
she offers
her congratulations all the
same.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The two of them promise each other to
share
another serious match in their next
race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро МакКуин then sets her sights on
her next
objective: the spring Tenno
Sho. She is eager to
show the
culmination of all her hard work.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
